title: Order list shows shipping status
summary: The order list now asks the shipping tracker for the status of each order and shows it next to the order. Creating an order also generates a tracking code. (Hand-written example of the change-metadata format; nacholens diff produces the same shape automatically.)

components.note: New trackShipping() calls the tracker for every order that has a tracking code; new orders get a TRK- code.
The list renders a readable shipping status per order.
New third-party dependency: GET /track per order.

steps.note: New call: one tracker lookup per order with a tracking code, run in parallel. A failure degrades to "unknown".
Each order now carries a shipping field.
The page prints the status next to each order.
The inserted row includes a generated tracking code.
